info.name: Collabspace API
info.description: Folders run top to bottom; destructive requests are in the last folder. Run order: 1) Register  2) Register helper: second user  3) List teams  4) Create project  5) Add member  6) Create task, then the rest (comments, files, chat, meetings).

request.description: Creates a user with a fresh random email and stores the token in {{token}}.
Creates another user to use as a project member. Does NOT change {{token}}.
Always 200. The link arrives in Mailpit (http://localhost:8025).
Email is read-only in v1. availability_status: available | busy | away.
jpg, jpeg, png or webp, max 2 MB.
Excludes yourself. Matches name (contains) or exact email.
You become the leader. Optional: members[] with user_id, team_id, job_title, role.
PUT replaces: name, priority, status, start_date and end_date are required.
Teams with members and tasks_done / tasks_total per member. Members without a team are in the 'Unassigned' group.
Run 'Register helper: second user' first. 422 if already a member.
The last leader cannot be demoted (422).
Any project member can create. status may be todo | in_progress | in_review (never completed).
Run 'Add member (leader)' first: assignees and the reviewer must be project members (422 otherwise).
Leader, creator or assignee. Never changes status or progress. Send assignee_ids[] to replace assignees.
progress applies only when the new status is in_progress.
Needs the reviewer if one is set (a leader can always). Completion forces progress = 100.
Max 10 MB. pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, ppt, pptx, png, jpg, jpeg, webp, txt, csv, md, json, sql, zip. task_id (optional) must belong to the same project.
Use 'Send and Download' in Postman. Members only; always served as an attachment.
Project channels + direct chats. Each project has one channel, created with the project.
Allowed only if you share a project with the user (403 otherwise). Returns 200 if the chat already exists.
Same whitelist and 10 MB limit as project files. body and/or attachment is required.
Set messageId to a message that has an attachment. Participants only.
starts_at must be in the future. With project_id every participant must be a project member; without it participants must share a project with you. meeting_url must be https.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Design review",
  "starts_at": "{{startsAt}}",
  "duration_minutes": 30,
  "meeting_url": "https://meet.example.com/design-review",
  "note": "Goal: agree on the homepage layout.",
  "project_id": "{{projectId}}",
  "participant_ids": [
    "{{otherUserId}}"
  ]
}

request.description: Meetings where you are organizer or participant. Default range: today to +30 days.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Design review (updated)",
  "starts_at": "{{startsAt}}",
  "duration_minutes": 30,
  "meeting_url": "https://meet.example.com/design-review",
  "note": "Goal: agree on the homepage layout.",
  "project_id": "{{projectId}}",
  "participant_ids": [
    "{{otherUserId}}"
  ]
}

request.description: Organizer and participants. speaker_id must be the organizer or a participant.
Needs at least one transcript entry (422 otherwise) and a configured AI provider (503 otherwise). Rate limit: 20/min.
Includes unread_count. Created when you are added to a project, assigned a task or invited to a meeting.
Task counters (tasks assigned to me), active projects, recent files, my tasks, upcoming meetings and the yearly project overview.
period: week | month | three_months | year. Rates include change_vs_last_period; series are monthly.
type: project_progress | task_performance | team_activity. The stats are stored as a snapshot. project_id is optional.
Min 2 characters. Up to 5 projects, 5 tasks and 5 files, only inside your projects.
Needs AI_BASE_URL, AI_API_KEY and AI_MODEL in .env (OpenAI-compatible). Returns 503 when the AI is not configured. Max 4000 characters, 20 requests/min.
Leader or the task creator.
After running this, update the {{password}} collection variable to NewSecret123.
